author: 3pvO
content: Decision: chose bridge option B (encode Cls.Frm directly against the structural denotation fdenote) over option A (translate Cls.Frm -> spine Strat.Frm). Reason: option A is ILL-DEFINED — the minimal spine Tm is var-only and cannot represent the Read/Len/Cast/IdxOp array-property vocabulary, and Atom.qf is carrier-closed, so an admitted formula like 'forall i. a[i] <= a[j]' has no image in the spine; there is no total meaning-preserving translation. fdenote (REQ-3) is design-stated stronger than any single per-sort model (holds for every (q,dom)), so encoder soundness against it subsumes any concrete per-sort sdenote. No forked syntax, no sorry.
